name: winci-android
description: WinCi Android (Capacitor shell around the built web UI)

scripts.build:web: npm --prefix ../web run build && rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp -a ../web/dist/. www/
scripts.build:debug: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
